text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Velox tenant (velox-prod) showing progressive queue growth and tail latency spikes in dedicated pool us-west-2-dedicated. Alert: queued_requests_per_tenant[velox-prod] > 200 for 5m, tail_latency_95 > 3.0s. Paging oncall.

amber_oncall: On it. Acked. Paging SREs + runtime. @raj_runtime can you grab metrics and logs? Any immediate mitigation we can apply without full deploy?

raj_runtime: Looking now — spikes started ~08:42 UTC. Traffic pattern: bursty batched requests from a Velox batch job. Per-tenant concurrent inflight is hitting the tenant queue limits and scheduler is coalescing huge batches. Snapshot of metrics (recent):
```
queued_requests_per_tenant{tenant="velox-prod"} = [240, 310, 420, 385]
tail_latency_ms{p95,tenant="velox-prod"} = 3200
error_rate{tenant="velox-prod"} = 4.6%
max_batch_tokens configured = 2048
```

raj_runtime: Root cause hypothesis: their request mix is creating very large merged batches (tokens/sec) causing head-of-line blocking and long KV cache warmups. We can tune scheduler knobs to cap merge size for this tenant (bespoke). Options:
- reduce `max_batch_tokens` for velox-prod to 512
- apply tenant-specific queue shaper (max_queue_length=200)
- enable immediate KV-cache warmup bypass for long-tail jobs

li_sre: Quick mitigation plan: 1) apply bespoke `max_batch_tokens=512` via runtime config patch for tenant velox-prod, 2) set tenant_shaper weight lower so it doesn't hog shared dispatchers, 3) if needed move velox to an isolated slot in dedicated pool (soft-isolate). I can roll 1 and 2 right now with no deploy.

amber_oncall: Please do 1 & 2 now. Notify Velox contact. Also prepare rollback steps.

raj_runtime: Applying patch to runtime config store (hot reload). Command (internal):
```
# update tenant config
curl -X POST https://internal-config/redwood/tenants/velox-prod -d '{"max_batch_tokens":512,"scheduler_shaper":{"weight":0.6,"max_queue_length":200}}'
```

deploy-bot: config-update: tenant velox-prod updated by raj_runtime at 1746543365. No service restart required. New config propagated to 3/3 runtime shards.

velox_oncall: Thanks for the heads up. We did start a large offline job at 08:40 UTC; it should finish in ~15-20m. Can you confirm we won't drop requests? This job is high-priority.

raj_runtime: We keep requests; this just limits merged batch size and reduces head-of-line. Initial effect: queue length down from 420 -> 180 within 40s. Tail latency p95 improved to ~800ms. Error rate fell to 1.2%. Full numbers:
```
queued_requests_per_tenant{velox-prod} ~ [420 -> 180 -> 110]
tail_latency_ms p95 ~ [3200 -> 1200 -> 780]
error_rate ~ [4.6% -> 1.2%]
```

li_sre: Good. Still seeing occasional spikes when the offline job emits very long sequences. As a precaution, I'm going to enable a temporary per-tenant fallback routing: if request queue time > 3s then route to smaller model variant `redwood-small-quant` for best-effort completion. Deploying canary rule now.

raj_runtime: Canary rule pushed.

deploy-bot: routing-rule-update: canary fallback for velox-prod enabled at 1746543420. 2/2 routers updated.

olivia_product: Noting customer impact: partial degradation mitigated, no dropped requests, some completions using fallback model (lower quality) — Velox will want a post-incident summary.

velox_oncall: Appreciate the quick mitigation. Fallback produced a few lower-quality responses but job completed. Please include which requests used fallback in the timeline.

amber_oncall: Handoff to li_sre for continued monitoring and postmortem. I'm going offline in 30m. @li_sre take ownership; if anything regresses escalate to runtime eng (@raj_runtime).

li_sre: Taking over. Current status: queue stable, p95 ~600-900ms, errors <1.5%. I will keep alerts damped and monitor for 1 hour. Creating an incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime for follow-up tuning session with Velox.

raj_runtime: Follow-ups we should include in postmortem: examine their client batching strategy (encourage smaller per-request token window), consider adding adaptive per-tenant quantization profile, and longer-term autoscaling knob to pre-empt large offline jobs. We'll schedule a tuning call with Velox SREs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident severity downgraded. Postmortem required. Link: https://redwood.incidents/1746543210

velox_oncall: Thanks team. We'll pause heavy jobs until we get tuned recommendations. Velox legal/ops want the final impact table.

amber_oncall: Great work all. If anything changes ping on this thread. :thumbsup:

li_sre: Logging actions taken in runbook snippet:
```
- Applied tenant config: max_batch_tokens=512
- Set scheduler_shaper.weight=0.6, max_queue_length=200
- Enabled fallback routing to redwood-small-quant when queue_time > 3s
- Monitored metrics for 30m, p95 dropped to ~800ms
- Created incident ticket and assigned postmortem
```

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging at 1746543510. Please proceed with PM and follow-up tasks.
